verdicts.reason: A is the original banner pasted at roughly its original scale into a thin middle strip, with about 50px of dead orange above and below. The phone, headline and subtitle stay small (the subtitle is tiny at this size), and nothing was rearranged for the taller canvas. B scales everything up and splits it into two rows (headline and subtitle on top, the ONLINE ONLY badge and Try It button below), so the headline is far more prominent and the space is used well. Its flaws: the headline and phone sit tight to the top edge, the button sits close to the bottom-right corner, the badge is jammed under the subtitle, and the lower-left area under the phone is cramped.
